description.de: API-Latenzen, Log-Analyse, DB-Performance, Frontend-Bundle-Größen messen — erstellt TODOs bei Problemen
description.en: Measure API latencies, analyze logs, DB performance, frontend bundle sizes — creates TODOs for issues

instructions: Du analysierst die Performance der MySuricates-Plattform. Sei praezise und melde nur echte, messbare Probleme. Bekannte Patterns: SQLite pool-size=1 (beabsichtigt), Claude CLI 5min Timeout (extern), TerminalPanel 329KB (xterm, korrekt lazy-loaded).

config.label: Backend-Performance messen
config.command:
BASE=/home/flo/Entwicklung/tools/autotrigger
API_KEY=$(python3 -c "import sqlite3; conn = sqlite3.connect('$BASE/ai-automation-backend/data/automation.db'); c = conn.cursor(); c.execute(\"SELECT value FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'api-key'\"); print(c.fetchone()[0]); conn.close()")

echo '========================================'
echo '  SYSTEM-METRIKEN'
echo '========================================'
echo '--- Load & CPU ---'
uptime
echo "CPU Kerne: $(nproc)"
echo ''
echo '--- Memory ---'
free -h
echo ''
echo '--- Disk ---'
df -h / | tail -1

echo ''
echo '========================================'
echo '  JVM-METRIKEN (Actuator)'
echo '========================================'
curl -s http://localhost:9090/actuator/metrics/jvm.memory.used 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "
import sys,json
try:
    d=json.load(sys.stdin)
    for m in d.get('measurements',[]):
        if m['statistic']=='VALUE': print(f'JVM Heap Used: {m["value"]/1024/1024:.0f} MB')
except: print('JVM: nicht verfuegbar')" || true
curl -s http://localhost:9090/actuator/metrics/jvm.memory.max 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "
import sys,json
try:
    d=json.load(sys.stdin)
    for m in d.get('measurements',[]):
        if m['statistic']=='VALUE' and m['value']>0: print(f'JVM Heap Max: {m["value"]/1024/1024:.0f} MB')
except: print('JVM Max: nicht verfuegbar')" || true
curl -s http://localhost:9090/actuator/metrics/jvm.gc.pause 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "
import sys,json
try:
    d=json.load(sys.stdin)
    for m in d.get('measurements',[]): print(f'GC {m["statistic"]}: {m["value"]:.3f}s')
except: print('GC: nicht verfuegbar')" || true

echo ''
echo '========================================'
echo '  API-ENDPOINT-LATENZEN'
echo '========================================'
for EP in \
  '/api/v1/system/health' \
  '/api/v1/workflows?projectId=ebf4f50c-20c2-4c35-a84a-a0b350124523&size=20' \
  '/api/v1/executions?size=50' \
  '/api/v1/todos?size=20' \
  '/api/v1/learning/dashboard' \
  '/api/v1/projects'; do
  TIME=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{time_total}' -H "X-API-Key: $API_KEY" "http://localhost:9090$EP" 2>/dev/null || echo 'FAIL')
  printf '  %6ss  %s\n' "$TIME" "$EP"
done

echo ''
echo '========================================'
echo '  DATENBANK-PERFORMANCE'
echo '========================================'
DB=$BASE/ai-automation-backend/data/automation.db
echo "DB-Groesse: $(du -sh $DB | cut -f1)"
python3 -c "
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('$DB')
c = conn.cursor()
c.execute('PRAGMA page_count')
pages = c.fetchone()[0]
c.execute('PRAGMA page_size')
page_size = c.fetchone()[0]
c.execute('PRAGMA freelist_count')
free = c.fetchone()[0]
print(f'Pages: {pages}, Page-Size: {page_size}B, Freelist: {free} ({free*page_size/1024/1024:.1f} MB fragmentiert)')
print()
print('Row-Counts (groesste Tabellen):')
c.execute(\"SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name\")
for (t,) in c.fetchall():
    try:
        c.execute(f'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {t}')
        n = c.fetchone()[0]
        if n > 0: print(f'  {n:>8}  {t}')
    except: pass
conn.close()"

echo ''
echo '========================================'
echo '  WORKFLOW-RUN-PERFORMANCE'
echo '========================================'
curl -s -H "X-API-Key: $API_KEY" 'http://localhost:9090/api/v1/executions?size=50' 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "
import sys,json
try:
    raw=json.load(sys.stdin)
    runs=raw if isinstance(raw,list) else raw.get('content',raw.get('data',[]))
    with_dur=[(r.get('workflowName','?'),r.get('durationMs',0),r.get('status','?')) for r in runs if r.get('durationMs')]
    with_dur.sort(key=lambda x:-x[1])
    print('Top-10 langsamste Runs:')
    for name,ms,status in with_dur[:10]:
        print(f'  {ms:>8}ms  [{status:>10}]  {name}')
    if with_dur:
        durs=sorted([d[1] for d in with_dur])
        print(f'\nMedian: {durs[len(durs)//2]}ms, P95: {durs[int(len(durs)*0.95)]}ms, Max: {durs[-1]}ms')
        print(f'Runs > 60s: {sum(1 for d in durs if d>60000)}, Runs > 5min: {sum(1 for d in durs if d>300000)}')
except Exception as e: print(f'Run-Analyse fehlgeschlagen: {e}')"

echo ''
echo '========================================='
echo '  LETZTER AUDIT-REPORT (falls vorhanden)'
echo '========================================='
API_KEY=$(python3 -c "import sqlite3; conn = sqlite3.connect('$BASE/ai-automation-backend/data/automation.db'); c = conn.cursor(); c.execute(\"SELECT value FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'api-key'\"); print(c.fetchone()[0]); conn.close()" 2>/dev/null || echo '')
if [ -n "$API_KEY" ]; then
  curl -s -H "X-API-Key: $API_KEY" 'http://localhost:9090/api/v1/executions?size=10' 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "
import json, sys
try:
    data = json.load(sys.stdin)
    runs = data if isinstance(data, list) else data.get('content', data.get('data', []))
    for r in runs:
        name = r.get('workflowName', '').lower()
        status = r.get('status', '')
        if  + NAME_FILTER +  in name and status in ('COMPLETED', 'COMPLETED_WITH_ERRORS', 'FAILED'):
            steps = sorted(r.get('steps', []), key=lambda s: len(s.get('output','') or ''), reverse=True)
            for s in steps:
                out = s.get('output', '') or ''
                if len(out) > 500 and s.get('status') == 'COMPLETED':
                    print(out[:3000])
                    break
            break
except: pass
" 2>/dev/null || echo '(Fehler beim Laden des vorherigen Reports)'
else
  echo '(API-Key nicht verfuegbar)'
fi

config.label: Log-Analyse
config.command:
LOG=/home/flo/Entwicklung/tools/autotrigger/ai-automation-backend/data/logs/mysuricates.log
ERRLOG=/home/flo/Entwicklung/tools/autotrigger/ai-automation-backend/data/logs/mysuricates-error.log

echo '========================================'
echo '  LOG-DATEIEN'
echo '========================================'
ls -lh /home/flo/Entwicklung/tools/autotrigger/ai-automation-backend/data/logs/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'Kein Log-Verzeichnis'

if [ ! -f "$LOG" ]; then
  echo 'Haupt-Log nicht gefunden'
  exit 0
fi

echo ''
echo '========================================'
echo '  ERROR/WARN ZAEHLUNG'
echo '========================================'
TODAY=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
YESTERDAY=$(date -d 'yesterday' +%Y-%m-%d 2>/dev/null || date -v-1d +%Y-%m-%d 2>/dev/null || echo '')
WEEK_AGO=$(date -d '7 days ago' +%Y-%m-%d 2>/dev/null || date -v-7d +%Y-%m-%d 2>/dev/null || echo '')

TOTAL_ERR=$(grep -c ' ERROR ' "$LOG" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
TOTAL_WARN=$(grep -c ' WARN ' "$LOG" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
TODAY_ERR=$(grep "$TODAY" "$LOG" 2>/dev/null | grep -c ' ERROR ' || echo 0)
TODAY_WARN=$(grep "$TODAY" "$LOG" 2>/dev/null | grep -c ' WARN ' || echo 0)

echo "Gesamt: $TOTAL_ERR ERRORs, $TOTAL_WARN WARNs"
echo "Heute ($TODAY): $TODAY_ERR ERRORs, $TODAY_WARN WARNs"

echo ''
echo '========================================'
echo '  TOP-10 HAEUFIGSTE ERRORS'
echo '========================================'
grep ' ERROR ' "$LOG" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^.*ERROR [^ ]* - //' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -10

echo ''
echo '========================================'
echo '  TIMEOUT / SLOW / EXCEEDED'
echo '========================================'
grep -i 'timeout\|timed out\|exceeded\|too long\|slow' "$LOG" 2>/dev/null | tail -15 || echo 'Keine Timeout-Eintraege'

echo ''
echo '========================================'
echo '  HIKARICP / DB-WARNUNGEN'
echo '========================================'
grep -i 'hikari\|connection.*wait\|pool.*exhaust\|SQLITE_BUSY\|database.*locked' "$LOG" 2>/dev/null | tail -10 || echo 'Keine HikariCP-Warnungen'

echo ''
echo '========================================'
echo '  MEMORY / GC WARNUNGEN'
echo '========================================'
grep -i 'OutOfMemory\|heap.*space\|GC overhead\|memory.*pressure' "$LOG" 2>/dev/null | tail -10 || echo 'Keine Memory-Warnungen'

echo ''
echo '========================================'
echo '  LETZTE 10 ERRORS (chronologisch)'
echo '========================================'
grep ' ERROR ' "$LOG" 2>/dev/null | tail -10 || echo 'Keine Errors'

config.label: Frontend-Performance messen
config.command:
BASE=/home/flo/Entwicklung/tools/autotrigger/ai-automation-frontend

echo '========================================'
echo '  FRONTEND BUNDLE-GROESSEN'
echo '========================================'
if [ -d "$BASE/dist/assets" ]; then
  echo '--- JS-Chunks > 50KB ---'
  find "$BASE/dist/assets" -name '*.js' -size +50k -exec ls -lhS {} + 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $5, $NF}' | sed "s|$BASE/dist/assets/||" | head -20
  echo ''
  echo '--- CSS ---'
  find "$BASE/dist/assets" -name '*.css' -exec ls -lhS {} + 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $5, $NF}' | sed "s|$BASE/dist/assets/||"
  echo ''
  TOTAL_JS=$(find "$BASE/dist/assets" -name '*.js' -exec cat {} + 2>/dev/null | wc -c)
  TOTAL_CSS=$(find "$BASE/dist/assets" -name '*.css' -exec cat {} + 2>/dev/null | wc -c)
  echo "Total JS: $((TOTAL_JS / 1024)) KB"
  echo "Total CSS: $((TOTAL_CSS / 1024)) KB"
else
  echo 'Kein dist-Verzeichnis — baue Frontend...'
  cd "$BASE" && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -5
  echo ''
  echo '--- JS-Chunks > 50KB ---'
  find "$BASE/dist/assets" -name '*.js' -size +50k -exec ls -lhS {} + 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $5, $NF}' | sed "s|$BASE/dist/assets/||" | head -20
fi

echo ''
echo '========================================'
echo '  DEPENDENCIES'
echo '========================================'
DEP_COUNT=$(python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('$BASE/package.json')); print(len(d.get('dependencies',{})))" 2>/dev/null || echo '?')
DEVDEP_COUNT=$(python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('$BASE/package.json')); print(len(d.get('devDependencies',{})))" 2>/dev/null || echo '?')
NM_SIZE=$(du -sh "$BASE/node_modules" 2>/dev/null | cut -f1 || echo '?')
echo "Dependencies: $DEP_COUNT, DevDependencies: $DEV_DEP_COUNT"
echo "node_modules: $NM_SIZE"

echo ''
echo '========================================'
echo '  GROESSTE QUELLDATEIEN (>300 LOC)'
echo '========================================'
find "$BASE/src" \( -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' \) -not -path '*/node_modules/*' | while read f; do
  l=$(wc -l < "$f")
  [ "$l" -gt 300 ] && echo "$l $(echo $f | sed "s|$BASE/src/||")"
done | sort -rn | head -10

config.label: Performance-Tiefenanalyse (Opus)
config.command:
Analysiere die Performance-Daten der MySuricates-Plattform:

{{ previous_output }}

Bewerte systematisch:

### API-Latenzen
- < 100ms = gut, 100-500ms = akzeptabel, 500ms-2s = langsam, > 2s = kritisch
- Welche Endpoints sind am langsamsten? Warum?
- Dashboard-Endpoint ist oft der Flaschenhals (aggregiert viele Daten)

### Datenbank
- DB-Groesse: > 100MB = pruefen, > 500MB = Cleanup noetig
- Fragmentierung: freelist_count > 10% der page_count = VACUUM empfehlen
- Grosse Tabellen: step_results und workflow_runs wachsen am schnellsten — Cleanup-Policy?
- Pool-Size=1 ist beabsichtigt (SQLite) — KEIN Finding

### JVM & System
- Heap > 70% = Warnung, > 85% = Alarm
- GC-Pausen > 500ms = Performance-Problem
- System-Load > CPU-Kerne = ueberlastet

### Logs
- Wiederkehrende Errors = Bug-Kandidaten
- Timeouts = Engpaesse identifizieren
- HikariCP-Warnungen = DB-Contention

### Frontend
- Chunks > 200KB = Splitting-Kandidaten
- Gesamt-JS > 2MB = zu gross
- Dashboard 443KB = Recharts koennte lazy-loaded werden
- index 632KB = Vendor-Chunk, schwer zu reduzieren

### Workflow-Runs
- Median > 60s = normal fuer Opus-Workflows
- Runs > 5min = potentiell haengend

BEKANNTE PATTERNS (KEIN Finding):
- SQLite pool-size=1
- Claude CLI 5min Timeout
- TerminalPanel 329KB (xterm, korrekt lazy-loaded)
- Lange Agentic-Runs (>5min) sind normal

Pro Finding: Schweregrad (CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW), Messwert, konkreter Fix.

## Report-Format

### Performance-Scorecard
| Bereich | Score (1-10) | Kritischster Befund |
|---------|-------------|--------------------|
| API-Latenzen | | |
| Datenbank | | |
| JVM/System | | |
| Logs/Errors | | |
| Frontend | | |
| Workflow-Runs | | |

### Top-5 Optimierungen
| # | Problem | Messwert | Fix | Aufwand | Erwartete Verbesserung |

gate_status: RED wenn CRITICAL, YELLOW wenn HIGH, GREEN wenn nur MEDIUM/LOW

VERGLEICH MIT LETZTEM RUN:
Falls unter "LETZTER AUDIT-REPORT" ein vorheriger Report vorhanden ist:
- Vergleiche die Findings: Was ist NEU, was war schon bekannt, was wurde GELOEST?
- Zeige einen Trend: Besser/Schlechter/Gleich
- Erstelle NUR todo_items fuer NEUE Findings (nicht fuer bereits bekannte)

config.label: Ergebnis erklären
config.command:
Fasse das Performance-Audit in maximal 5 Zeilen zusammen:

{{ previous_output }}

- Gesamtbewertung der Performance
- Langsamster API-Endpoint und Latenz
- Groesster Befund aus den Logs
- Frontend-Bundle-Status

Am Ende GENAU diese Zeile:
gate_status: GREEN wenn Performance akzeptabel, YELLOW wenn Optimierungsbedarf, RED wenn kritische Engpaesse

config.label: Gate-Verdict
config.command:
PREV='{{ previous_output }}'

if echo "$PREV" | grep -qi 'gate_status: RED'; then
  echo 'Performance-Audit: KRITISCH'
  echo 'gate_status: RED'
  echo 'gate_category: performance'
  echo 'gate_description: Kritische Performance-Engpaesse gefunden'
elif echo "$PREV" | grep -qi 'gate_status: YELLOW'; then
  echo 'Performance-Audit: Optimierungsbedarf'
  echo 'gate_status: YELLOW'
  echo 'gate_category: performance'
  echo 'gate_description: Performance-Optimierungen empfohlen'
else
  echo 'Performance-Audit: OK'
  echo 'gate_status: GREEN'
  echo 'gate_category: performance'
  echo 'gate_description: Performance akzeptabel'
fi
